units.title: Bind one exact claimed session to one durable outcome selection
units.objective: Preserve explicit goal authority on simple sequential write claims without weakening numbered-plan graph readiness, persist one create-once immutable outcome selection in the exact claim-linked tracker, resolve it through the existing pre-write observer, and prove real positive, circular negative, authority-mismatch, and stale/tampered behavior without changing ordinary admission.

included: Strict outcome-selection binding with stable exact-claim identity
Explicit planned or genuine goal authority with fail-loud mismatch behavior
Goal-bound sequential write claims without manufactured graph artifacts, while numbered plans retain graph and unit requirements
Locked atomic writes in the existing session tracker
Create-once explicit selection through the outcome-continuation CLI
Selected observation through the existing pre-write wrapper
Binding metadata on selected success and typed visible failures
Focused identity, authority, tamper, preservation, both-sign, and compatibility tests
One real Plan 117 selected positive observation and one isolated circular control
Plan, work graph, index, roadmap, and evidence reconciliation
excluded: Automatic semantic outcome selection or Project Graph lineage lookup
Mutable lease renewal, progress authoring, recovery, restart, break-glass, or WIP enforcement
Claim or pre-write projection schema changes
Default hook activation, outcome blocking, or shell interception
Installer, downstream repository, colleague, fleet, deployment, or release changes
Bulk project status changes, another planning framework, or cost controls

outputs: One strict create-once outcome selection with canonical plan-or-goal authority in the existing exact-session tracker
One narrow claim-validation rule that preserves goal authority without weakening numbered-plan graph readiness
One atomic tracker mutation seam shared by lifecycle and selection writers
One selected pre-write option that never accepts a caller scenario
Selected would-allow, would-deny, and stale/tampered visible-failure evidence
Operator guidance for goal-bound writes and manual selected observation
A revision- and digest-bound owner-real observation with truthful promotion limits

acceptance.criterion: One exact live claimed session stores one strict create-once selection with explicit plan-or-goal authority in its existing linked tracker with locked atomic mutation.
evidence_required: Planned authority preservation, plan-to-unplanned mismatch, and explicit goal authority tests
Goal-bound write claim succeeds without graph and numbered-plan write claim still fails without graph and unit
Atomic tracker write and unrelated-field preservation tests
acceptance.negative_control: A different scenario cannot replace the selected binding, and a plan-shaped authority cannot bind a null or UNPLANNED claim.

acceptance.criterion: Selected lookup binds stable exact claim, tracker, session, repository, worktree, branch, claim source, and immutable scenario identity.
acceptance.negative_control: A replacement session or changed scenario records a typed observation error and cannot borrow the old selection.

acceptance.criterion: The existing pre-write wrapper resolves selected state only after recording the ordinary decision and preserves no-option, explicit-scenario, and native exit behavior.
acceptance.negative_control: A selected observation error leaves the ordinary decision and exit code unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: The selected path produces would_allow for owner progress and would_deny for a same-contract circular control.
evidence_required: Revision-, receipt-, tracker-, selection-, scenario-, contract-, and lease-digest evidence
acceptance.negative_control: Approval text, cost, elapsed time, and ordinary admission do not distinguish the two signs.

acceptance.criterion: The result is retained as a manual observe pilot and makes no automatic-selection, mutable-lease, enforcement, installation, shell, colleague, or fleet claim.
acceptance.negative_control: No projection schema, installer, host hook, downstream repository, or blocking-mode file changes appear in the submitted revision.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live Plan 117 claim owns only the listed claim-validation, selection, tracker, wrapper, tests, scenarios, evidence, operator guide, plan, graph, index, and roadmap paths.
